lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six visible vertical columns along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that coincide with the centroids of the circular blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three horizontal linear segments in the upper third of the visible flank characterized by high-intensity pixel values along the superior edge and lower-intensity pixel values along the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin visible in the lower-central field of view exhibits a high density of small-diameter high-luminance blobs compared to the primary lateral flank.
